From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR preflight: forecast harmonization & exec talking points

Team —

We have Nimbus Logistics on the QBR deck next Thursday (exec slot). I need a tidy, consolidated forecast and concise account-level talking points for the top 12 deals by ARR so execs can call out risk and required plays. Key asks: 

1) Review the attached QBR_forecast_v3.xlsx and update the 'Likelihood' and 'Close delta' columns inline where you own deals. Use the BLUE sheet for the lead number.

2) For the top 12 accounts (sorted by ARR in the workbook), add a 2–3 line executive talking point each in Account_Talking_Points.docx: current status, top risk (impact), mitigation ask (owner + timeline).

3) Call out any material movement vs. last quarter (>$50k ARR change) and mark with "DELTA" in the sheet.

Deadlines: please return updates by EOD Friday Pacific (2027-05-21) so I can consolidate Monday morning and produce the exec one-pager.

Extra context: Nimbus is asking for stronger SLA commitments and a potential custom routing trial. We need to ensure forecast reflects any extension requests; sales contact is Nikhil (cc'd below once we have public-facing talking points).

Attachments: QBR_forecast_v3.xlsx; Account_Talking_Points.docx

Thanks — appreciate quick turn on this.

Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR preflight: forecast harmonization & exec talking points

Irene —

Quick pass from my book (attached small CSV of my adjustments). Pulled the top 5 that I own/cover and pasted micro-summaries below to seed the doc: 

Account: Nimbus Logistics (DEAL-8742)
- Status: Contract negotiation; procurement wants a 60-day data residency clause.
- Top risk: SLA/contracting delay pushes close past EoQ.
- Mitigation ask: Offer 30-day pilot with standard SLA + escalation path; Sales owner: Jordan Blake; ETA: 2027-06-15.

Account: Orion Freight (DEAL-8120)
- Status: Proof-of-concept complete; engineering sign-off pending.
- Top risk: Quantization/latency concerns for 2k seq payloads.
- Mitigation ask: Engineering pairing session + custom batching profile; Sales owner: Markus Klein; ETA: 2027-05-28.

Account: Meridian Coldchain (DEAL-8334)
- Status: Legal requested redlines on data retention terms.
- Top risk: Contract hold for policy review.
- Mitigation ask: Offer optional retention configuration + SOC2 evidence; Sales owner: Priyom Das; ETA: 2027-06-01.

I updated the BLUE sheet with 'Likelihood' changes for the above (increases of ~10% for Orion, -15% for Nimbus to reflect procurement friction). See attached forecast-adjustments.csv for the numeric deltas.

Markus

Attachment: forecast-adjustments.csv (columns: deal_id, previous_amt, new_amt, delta_pct)

- Topline movement: Consolidated pipeline decreased $210k ARR from last quarter; primary driver: Nimbus procurement delay (see DEAL-8742).
- Actions approved:
  * Offer 30-day pilot to Nimbus (Jordan to own comms).
  * Prioritize Orion latency work; engineering pairing session scheduled 2027-05-25 (Markus).

Nikhil/Elena (Nimbus) — I will share the public-facing slide after we finalize the pilot scope early next week.

Thanks for the quick turns. Will prepare a short runbook for the exec meeting (timings / owner script) and circulate Monday AM.

Irene
